visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman in a white ribbed sleeveless top speaking directly to a handheld camera in a neutral-toned indoor hallway. She uses active hand gestures and expressive facial movements, particularly focusing her eyes on the camera lens. The lighting is bright and even across her face. (2) She transitions to a kitchen setting, holding various food packages such as marinated chicken in plastic, a large tub of lettuce, and small tomatoes. The background features dark wood cabinetry and kitchen appliances. She displays each item at eye level to ensure clarity for the viewer. (3) She is shown bending down to interact with a white Philips air fryer on a low shelf. She carefully lines the basket with parchment paper and places pieces of raw chicken inside. The camera angle shifts to a slightly higher perspective to capture the top of the appliance. (4) On a clean white countertop, she assembles a salad across two white plates. She uses her hands to arrange lettuce leaves and cucumber slices, then uses a spoon to distribute canned corn. The shot is a medium close-up focusing on the food preparation. (5) She holds four brown eggs before cracking them into a grey bowl. She is shown adding salt and sugar from containers, then whisking the mixture vigorously with chopsticks. The visual focus is primarily on her hands and the bowl, with text overlays at the bottom. (6) In a final cooking sequence, she sprays a stainless steel pan with oil and pours the egg mixture in. Visible steam and motion occur as she stirs the eggs. The video concludes with a top-down shot of the finished plates containing chicken, eggs, and salad.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 上次在IG問大家 [Slogan]: 最想看我分享什麼短片. (2) [Subtitle]: 結果最多人留言的是想看我的日常(?). (3) [Subtitle]: 所以我想說那就今天來分享我平常早餐要怎麼準備吧! 料理白痴的料理廚房開始. (4) [Subtitle]: 今天要準備的食材有~ 雞胸肉 奶油波士頓 還有番茄 小黃瓜 還有雞蛋 玉米 沙拉醬. (5) [Subtitle]: 煮飯一段時間就發現想要讓每道菜都剛好熱的就要抓那個做料理的順序 所以通常會先加熱氣炸鍋. (6) [Subtitle]: 常用氣炸鍋推薦你們可以買這個烘焙紙 直接放進去~ (7) [Subtitle]: 雞肉放進去之後我們就開始弄沙拉 喜歡吃生菜大推這個奶油波士頓超好吃! [Variety]: (簡單到羞愧). (8) [Subtitle]: 外食很容易蔬菜量不夠所以我都盡量早上可以多吃一點青菜 小黃瓜 番茄 玉米 完成! [Variety]: 完成!. (9) [Subtitle]: 再來我會準備5顆蛋 [Variety]: (蛋白質很重要) [Subtitle]: 一匙半的海鹽 加一點點糖 攪拌均勻. (10) [Subtitle]: 這時後氣炸鍋好一半了所以我們來翻面 因為氣炸鍋大概還要10分鐘 [Variety]: (開不下來的me). (11) [Subtitle]: 如果太快炒蛋的話蛋到時候就會冷掉了所以我就會趁這段時間稍微收拾一下 我都會買這種噴的酪梨油很方便. (12) [Subtitle]: 稍微有點冒煙就可以開始下蛋 雞肉出爐~ 完成! [Variety]: 完成!.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and quick cooking tutorial designed to share a healthy and easy breakfast routine with the creator's audience. By documenting the step-by-step preparation of a salad with chicken and eggs, the creator promotes a balanced diet and demonstrates that cooking can be simple even for those who identify as 'cooking illiterates.'
